title: 市场棚
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Re-render this single Yuan northern China building sprite to correct its CAMERA and rectangular ground proportions. Keep the same muted realistic matte materials, age, fine details, upper-left light, short lower-right shadow and anonymous Yuan subject. The current ground is too steep. Replace projection with exact orthographic DIMETRIC yaw45 pitch30, NOT standard 35.264 isometric. Both ground diagonals are shallower: exact screen slopes +0.5 and -0.5, screen angle 26.565 degrees. Footprint is 5m by 4m. From the leftmost ground corner to the bottom/front ground corner, horizontal run must be 1.2500 times the horizontal run from bottom/front to rightmost ground corner. Keep all parallel lines parallel; make this thin ground-contact rectangle very clear, not a thick raised base. Build the walls and roofs upright above that corrected plane. The source image angles must NOT be preserved. TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENT background, alpha0 outside object; 10 percent empty margin every side, whole roof and base visible. No text, grid, dimensions, labels, people or additional surroundings. CRITICAL SUBJECT CORRECTION: remove the entire tiled house and ALL masonry walls. The ONLY structure is a freestanding four-post market stall with a coarse tan cloth canopy, one wooden counter, sacks and clay jars. No tiled roof, no permanent building anywhere.
selection_note: 选第二候选：已去掉首版瓦屋，市场布棚功能正确；底面偏狭长且双轴偏浅，不能作严密拼接金样。
